title: MergeOutput
description: Consolidated task list after merging similar pending tasks.

merged_tasks.description: The consolidated task list. Every original pending task must be represented — either kept as-is or merged into a broader task. Never silently drop a task.

merge_notes.description: Records which original tasks were merged together so the operator can audit the consolidation.

original_task_ids.description: Two or more task_ids that were collapsed into one.

merged_into.description: The task_id of the consolidated task that replaces them.

rationale.description: Why these tasks were merged — shared attack class, overlapping target files, same trust boundary, etc.
